outgoingFlows.description: Transmission of the influenza virus from infectious to susceptible individuals through contact.
Progression of individuals from the latent (Exposed) state to the infectious state.
Recovery of individuals from the infectious state, after which they are no longer infectious and are immune.

parameters.name: R0
parameters.description: Basic reproduction number. The paper focuses on a 'moderate' scenario of 1.7 and a 'high' scenario of 2.0.

parameters.name: Generation time
parameters.description: The assumed generation time of the influenza virus.

parameters.name: Proportion of clinical cases
parameters.description: The proportion of infected individuals who become ill enough to be classified as clinical cases.

parameters.name: Household transmission proportion
parameters.description: The proportion of total transmission estimated to occur within households for the United States.

parameters.name: Community transmission proportion
parameters.description: The proportion of total transmission estimated to occur in the general community (33% of the 70% of transmission outside the household).

parameters.name: School and workplace transmission proportion
parameters.description: The proportion of total transmission estimated to occur in schools and workplaces (37% of the 70% of transmission outside the household).

parameters.name: Matched vaccine efficacy (susceptibility reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in susceptibility to infection for individuals who receive a matched pandemic vaccine.

parameters.name: Matched vaccine efficacy (infectiousness reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in infectiousness for vaccinated individuals who still become infected.

parameters.name: Matched vaccine efficacy (clinical case reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in the probability of becoming a clinical case for vaccinated individuals who still become infected.

parameters.name: Pre-pandemic vaccine efficacy (susceptibility reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in susceptibility conferred by a pre-prepared vaccine against the source avian virus.

uncertainty_analysis.methodologyNotes: This task is **parameter uncertainty quantification**: documenting uncertainty about **numerical parameter values** in the .compmodel (not structural or stochastic uncertainty). Confidence is **mostly Unknown** unless a small built-in heuristic matches the disease name (COVID-19, Malaria, HIV) and parameter name substrings — assigning High/Medium/Low requires curated literature ranges or expert review; see Phase 1 README (Validity & limitations).
